tf.prompt: The Neolithic spans roughly 10,000–3,000 BCE, the longest period listed.
tf.explanation: The guide gives this approximate range.

tf.prompt: Uruk is associated with early cities, state formation, and proto-writing.
tf.explanation: The card gives these as Uruk features.

tf.prompt: The Uruk vase is an alabaster vessel with stacked registers of crops, sheep, produce bearers, and offerings to Inanna.
tf.explanation: Those materials and scenes are listed on the card.

tf.prompt: Beveled-rim bowls were crude, standardized, mass-produced, likely ration bowls for workers.
tf.explanation: The card gives that description and likely function.

tf.prompt: Tokens sealed in bullae illustrate the accounting practices from which writing developed.
tf.explanation: The card connects accounting to the origin of writing.

tf.prompt: Çatalhöyük was a dense Neolithic mudbrick town with no streets and roof entry.
tf.explanation: Those features are listed on the card.

tf.prompt: Hammurabi’s stele shows him before Shamash and laws that differ by social class.
tf.explanation: The card identifies both the image and class differences in the laws.

tf.prompt: Workers’ villages at Giza support the account of organized, fed labor crews building Khufu’s pyramid.
tf.explanation: The card says the villages show organized, fed crews; the slave labor claim is a myth.

tf.prompt: Amarna was Akhenaten’s new capital for the Aten and was abandoned after him.
tf.explanation: The card gives both details.

tf.prompt: Kushite kings ruled Egypt as the 25th Dynasty.
tf.explanation: The Kush/Nubia card states this.

tf.prompt: Kerma elite tombs had round graves with cattle skulls and food or drink offerings outside.
tf.explanation: Those burial features are listed on the card.

tf.prompt: Ashurnasirpal II’s Banquet Stele records a 10-day feast for 69,574 guests.
tf.explanation: The card gives the feast duration and guest count.

tf.prompt: The Black Obelisk shows Jehu of Israel bowing among five tribute registers.
tf.explanation: The card describes the registers and Jehu scene.

tf.prompt: The Cyrus Cylinder presents Marduk choosing Cyrus over Nabonidus and describes restored temples and returned deportees.
tf.explanation: These are details listed on the card.

tf.prompt: Persepolis reliefs show about 23 subject peoples bringing gifts in distinct dress.
tf.explanation: The card describes the Apadana procession.

tf.prompt: Isaiah 44–45 calls Cyrus God’s “anointed” and “shepherd” and welcomes Persian rule from a Judean perspective.
tf.explanation: These phrases and interpretation are in the card.

tf.prompt: The Dead Sea Scrolls include biblical books and sectarian texts, reflecting Second Temple Jewish diversity.
tf.explanation: The card lists both textual types and this significance.

tf.prompt: Alexander’s conquest of the Achaemenid Empire began the Hellenistic period and spread Hellenism.
tf.explanation: The card identifies this as his significance.

tf.prompt: Sasanian Magic Bowls were inscribed across religious lines and used to trap demons.
tf.explanation: The card describes their spells, use, and religious diversity.

tf.prompt: A racial hinge occurs when a court ruling about one group shifts how adjacent groups are classified; the lecture contrasts Armenian Christian and Persian Zoroastrian cases.
tf.explanation: That is the updated card definition of racial hinge.

tf.prompt: Hammurabi wrote the first law code ever.
tf.explanation: Ur-Namma’s earlier law collection disproves this class myth.

tf.prompt: Enslaved people built Khufu’s Great Pyramid, according to the workers’ villages.
tf.explanation: The card says the villages show organized fed crews; the slave claim is false.

tf.prompt: The Uruk vase is a clay accounting tablet without imagery.
tf.explanation: It is an alabaster vessel with carved stacked registers and a procession.

tf.prompt: The Cyrus Cylinder was the first human-rights charter.
tf.explanation: The card calls this a myth; it is standard Mesopotamian royal propaganda.

tf.prompt: Beveled-rim bowls were rare luxury vessels found only in royal tombs.
tf.explanation: They were mass-produced and found by the hundreds of thousands.

tf.prompt: Çatalhöyük had streets and a clear state elite.
tf.explanation: The card describes no streets and no state or clear elite.

tf.prompt: Amarna was founded for Amun and remained occupied after Akhenaten.
tf.explanation: It was a capital for the Aten and was abandoned after Akhenaten.

tf.prompt: Napatan rulers never challenged Assyrian control of the southern Levant.
tf.explanation: The guide says Kush eventually challenged Assyria for control of the southern Levant.

tf.prompt: The Black Obelisk depicts Alexander bringing tribute to Shalmaneser III.
tf.explanation: It shows Jehu of Israel bowing in a tribute register.

tf.prompt: Persepolis reliefs show only Persians and no subject peoples.
tf.explanation: They depict about 23 subject peoples bringing gifts.

tf.prompt: The Dead Sea Scrolls contain only biblical books and no sectarian texts.
tf.explanation: The card lists sectarian texts as well as biblical material.

tf.prompt: Alexander founded the Achaemenid Empire.
tf.explanation: He conquered it; successor Hellenistic kingdoms followed.

tf.prompt: Hellenism means Greek culture replaced every local tradition without blending.
tf.explanation: Herakles-Bahram illustrates blending, not replacement.

tf.prompt: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians says gentile converts must accept circumcision and Torah.
tf.explanation: The card says they did not need circumcision or Torah.

tf.prompt: The Account of the Deeds of Ardashir is a Roman Latin account of Alexander.
tf.explanation: It is a Middle Persian Sasanian text about Ardashir and dynastic legitimacy.

tf.prompt: Magic Bowls were exclusively Zoroastrian and written in only one language.
tf.explanation: They were used across religious lines and include Jewish Aramaic, Syriac, or Mandaic.

tf.prompt: Orientalism portrays the East as progressive and unchangingly superior to the West.
tf.explanation: The card describes discourse depicting the East as exotic, backward, and unchanging to justify domination.

tf.prompt: Mesopotamian essentialized difference was based on physical or linguistic traits just as in modern US court cases.
tf.explanation: The card says ancient differences centered on lifestyle, not physical or linguistic traits.

tf.prompt: Race is a biological category while ethnicity is cultural.
tf.explanation: Both are social; race organizes essentialized difference into hierarchy.

tf.prompt: Zoroastrianism was unrelated to kingship in the Sasanian period.
tf.explanation: The card says Sasanians made it the state religion and ties kingship to religion.
